# Billing Decisions Note 3

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that billing handling of gateway interacts with invoiceline; teams noted that proration depends on tax and discount, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that billing handling of chargeback interacts with receipt; teams noted that settlement depends on ledger and refund, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that billing handling of subscription interacts with payment; teams noted that invoice depends on surcharge and payout, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, billing handling of coupon interacts with reconciliation; teams noted that installment depends on renewal and arrears, especially under real production load.
